generators.carrier: grid divisions, BigRational delta, max depth

relations.statement: The overall minimum rational over the deltoid boxes is positive
relations.hypotheses: Kernel-reflection check of the box data passes; this covers only the boxes, not the cusp collars

lemmas.statement: At each of the three cusps of the Szollosi deltoid, the Puiseux expansion of the overlap residual has a nonzero leading coefficient, so the cusps and affine-leaf endpoints carry no roots.

near_misses.claim: Positivity of the minimum over the deltoid boxes implies no roots at the cusps
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The ledger lists the three cusp collars as uncovered, and the residual vanishes to higher order at a cusp, so box-interior positivity does not extend to the cusps.

open_obligations: Compute the Puiseux expansions of the overlap residual at each of the three cusps
Certify that the leading coefficients are nonzero
Produce cusp-collar certificates for the three uncovered collars
Define the residual in Lean and prove the lemma sorry-free
No grounded composition between the listed generators and the cusp claim
